description: A date-span field: one trigger, one <Calendar>, two picks. The first click marks the start, the second closes with the ordered range (picking backwards swaps the ends instead of failing). One date is <DatePicker>; this is the from/to filter over a list or a report. Copy: the label names the span — "Reporting period" — and never says "from/to", which the two halves already say.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires once both ends are picked, already ordered.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for the shown dates + the calendar. Defaults to document lang.

props.name: surface
props.description: Which surface the field sits on; same contract as <DatePicker>.

props.name: size
props.description: sm / md (default) / lg — matches the shared control height/padding scale.
